comment: HOW TO PLAY (ADR-007): each lesson is a ball-machine drill with rules and a goal. Lines are caps (the house style). Spots are metres on your side (x right, z from the net); "serve" puts you on the serve spot.

lessons.title: FIRST HITS
lines: THE MACHINE FEEDS YOU THE BALL.
SWING THROUGH IT AND SEND IT
BACK OVER THE NET.

lessons.title: THE SERVE
lines: HOLD THE BALL OUT AND PULL THE TRIGGER
TO LET IT GO. HIT IT UNDERHAND INTO
THE BOX DIAGONALLY ACROSS.

lessons.title: LET IT BOUNCE
lines: THE TWO-BOUNCE RULE: THE SERVE AND ITS
RETURN MUST EACH BOUNCE BEFORE ANYONE
VOLLEYS. LET IT BOUNCE, THEN HIT.

lessons.title: THE DINK
lines: AT THE KITCHEN LINE, PUSH THE BALL
SOFTLY OVER THE NET SO IT LANDS
IN THEIR KITCHEN.

lessons.title: THE KITCHEN
lines: VOLLEY THE BALL OUT OF THE AIR, BUT
KEEP YOUR FEET OUT OF THE KITCHEN
WHEN YOU DO: NO VOLLEYS IN THERE.

lessons.title: GO DEEP
lines: A DEEP BALL KEEPS THEM BACK.
LAND YOUR RETURNS IN THE BACK
THIRD OF THEIR COURT.

lessons.title: TOPSPIN
lines: BRUSH UP THE BACK OF THE BALL
AS YOU HIT IT. TOPSPIN DIPS IT
DOWN AND KICKS IT ON.
